mapper.select: SELECT ur.unit_id, ur.bldg_id, ur.move_in_dt, ur.mbr_cd, b.bldg_id AS b_bldg_id, b.bldg_nm AS b_bldg_nm, b.bldg_img_path AS b_bldg_img_path, b.bldg_addr AS b_bldg_addr, b.bldg_dtl_addr AS b_bldg_dtl_addr, u.unit_id AS u_unit_id, u.unit_room AS u_unit_room FROM unit_resident ur JOIN building b ON ur.bldg_id = b.bldg_id JOIN unit u ON ur.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE ur.mbr_cd = #{mbrCd} AND ur.unit_del_yn = 'N'

SELECT ur.unit_id, ur.bldg_id, ur.move_in_dt, ur.mbr_cd, b.bldg_id AS b_bldg_id, b.bldg_nm AS b_bldg_nm, b.bldg_img_path AS b_bldg_img_path, b.bldg_addr AS b_bldg_addr, b.bldg_dtl_addr AS b_bldg_dtl_addr, u.unit_id AS u_unit_id, u.unit_room AS u_unit_room FROM unit_resident ur JOIN building b ON ur.bldg_id = b.bldg_id JOIN unit u ON ur.unit_id = u.unit_id WHERE ur.bldg_id = #{bldgId} AND ur.mbr_cd = #{mbrCd} AND ur.unit_del_yn = 'N' AND ur.move_in_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT B.BLDG_ID, B.BLDG_NM, RB.RSD_BRD_ID, BD.BRD_TITL_NM AS RSD_BRD_TITL, TO_CHAR(BD.BRD_CONT) AS RSD_BRD_CONT, RB.RSD_BRD_PBLS_DTM, RB.MBR_CD, RB.OPEN_YN, RB.REQ_STATUS FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BLDG_ID FROM UNIT_RESIDENT WHERE MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} AND UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' AND MOVE_IN_DT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MOVE_IN_DT ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) UR JOIN BUILDING B ON B.BLDG_ID = UR.BLDG_ID JOIN RESIDENT_BOARD RB ON RB.BLDG_ID = UR.BLDG_ID JOIN BOARD BD ON BD.BRD_NO = RB.RSD_BRD_ID WHERE RB.RSD_BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' AND BD.BRD_CODE = 'M0001' ORDER BY RB.RSD_BRD_PBLS_DTM DESC

SELECT ur.*, u.UNIT_CMAR, u.UNIT_DSR_MNTH_RENT_AMT, u.UNIT_DSR_SALE_AMT FROM UNIT_RESIDENT ur JOIN UNIT u ON ur.UNIT_ID = u.UNIT_ID WHERE ur.UNIT_ID = #{unitId} AND ur.UNIT_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY ur.MBR_CD
